---
title: "Coronavirus means globalisation has suffered but we must not give up on trade links"
date: "2020-04-17"
---

I have an op-ed at [ABC Online](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-04-17/coronavirus-globalisation-setback-maintain-trade-links/12146876) arguing that the current disruptions to the global economy dramatise the hidden benefits of globalisation. We can now see more clearly than ever the extent to which our standard of living depends on integration with the global economy.
